Property Overview

A park-like setting, minutes from everywhere you need to be.

We're three miles east of the St. Charles Convention Center and Historic St. Charles, and just across the bridge from Main Street's dining and entertainment. A complimentary shuttle connects you to the airport, Hollywood Casino, and offices within three miles of the hotel.

Take a break by the pond, wander our walking trails, or cool off in the seasonal outdoor pool — all just steps from your room.

"You'll enjoy our park-like setting, where you can take a break by the pond or discover our walking trails."
